column1: # P/03 refusal catalogue: a form norm. UTF-8, LF, literal TAB, no CSV quoting. Empty cell is -.
# The N4 cells are: cause/outcome/diagnostic/caller for four-cell tables; word/outcome/cause for 3.7.
# In the first 3.2 table, Code and Body are outcome and diagnostic. Their em dash is preserved; it is not a missing table row.
# surface: start (process start), process (a running process), call (library result), peer (an imported door contract).
# code: a fixed HTTP code, exit N, exit !0 or -; - also covers a conditional code explicitly listed in outcome (401/503,403/401).
# kind is -: P/03 owns no HTTP contract. In particular peer.error is not P/01 Fault.kind. fields/headers/log supplement, never erase the normative cells.
